root_cause.text: ccs_mode_store() called xe_gt_reset() without first acquiring an outer runtime PM reference, violating the requirement that xe_pm_runtime_get_noresume() must be invoked only when such a reference is already held.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that "ccs_mode_store() calls xe_gt_reset() which internally invokes xe_pm_runtime_get_noresume(). That function requires the caller to already hold an outer runtime PM reference and warns if none is held," and the fix adds a `guard(xe_pm_runtime)` to protect the `xe_gt_reset()` call, ensuring the required reference is held.
